hooks.name: Keep the wallet code card in sync
hooks.description: When pager codes change, make sure every code has a row on the wallet code card and in the README.

action.prompt: src/engine/codes.ts changed. Check that every code in CODE_FOR, plus the boot and missed codes, has an entry in CODE_CARD with a plain-language meaning, that src/app/components/CodeCard.tsx still renders them all, and that the code table in README.md matches. Fix any mismatch and run `npm test`.
